On origin/main gitops/resources/prometheus-alerts.yaml lines 110-173 define five Down alerts as sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_status_ready * on (namespace, pod) kube_pod_labels{label_app_kubernetes_io_*=...}) == 0. kube-prometheus-stack 86.2.3 bundles kube-state-metrics whose values.yaml has `metricLabelsAllowlist: []` (line 393 of charts/kube-state-metrics/values.yaml), and the repo never overrides it (grep metricLabels/kube-state-metrics in gitops/ finds nothing), so kube_pod_labels has no label_* series, the join is an empty vector and no comparison with 0 yields a sample: none of the five can fire. TraefikDown additionally selects a replaced component (scripts/cluster/08-1-networking.sh:74).
